en.title: Taiwan MND detects 4 PLA aircraft sorties, 8 vessels and 1 official ship around Taiwan Strait
en.summary: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense said it detected 4 PLA aircraft sorties, 8 PLA vessels and 1 official ship around the Taiwan Strait from 6 a.m. on November 9 to 6 a.m. on November 10, and that the military monitored the activity and responded.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense said that from 6 a.m. on November 9 to 6 a.m. on November 10, it detected 4 People's Liberation Army (PLA) aircraft sorties, 8 PLA vessels and 1 official ship continuing activities in the areas around the Taiwan Strait.

The ministry said Taiwan's military monitored the activity and responded with mission aircraft and vessels as well as land-based missile systems, keeping a close watch on the situation around the Taiwan Strait.

facts.claim: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense reported that from 6 a.m. on November 9 to 6 a.m. on November 10, it detected 4 PLA aircraft sorties, 8 PLA vessels and 1 official ship continuing activities around the Taiwan Strait.
Taiwan's military monitored the activity and responded using mission aircraft and vessels and land-based missile systems.

zh.title: 國防部偵獲共機4架次、共艦8艘及1艘公務船在臺海周邊活動
zh.summary: 國防部表示，自11月9日上午6時至11月10日上午6時止，偵獲共機4架次、共艦8艘及公務船1艘，持續在臺海周邊活動；國軍運用任務機、艦及岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控與應處。
body: 國防部11月10日公布，自11月9日上午6時至11月10日上午6時止，偵獲共機4架次、共艦8艘及公務船1艘，持續在臺海周邊活動。
國防部指出，國軍運用任務機、艦及岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控與應處，持續掌握臺海周邊動態。
